## Task 3 — Verify before acting on project_part_3_base_map.ipynb

Before deleting anything, check: does `project_mapping_emotions/project_part_3_base_map.ipynb` differ meaningfully from `project_part_3_interactive_tour.ipynb`? 

- If the first ~10 cells are identical (same markdown intro, same SCHOOL variable setup, same data loading logic) and both notebooks write to `interactive_tour_config.js`, then `base_map` is redundant and can be moved to `instructor/project_part_3_base_map.ipynb`.
- If `base_map` contains unique content not in `interactive_tour`, report what differs and do NOT delete it — flag for manual review instead.

Use `git mv` to move (not delete) so history is preserved.

`project_mapping_emotions/assets/` is an empty directory. Remove it (git does not track empty directories, but a `.gitkeep` may exist — remove that too if present).

## Task 5 — Fix the team_static.html broken reference

Open `lesson_1_the_team/team_static.html`. It references `COLLABORATION_GUIDE.md` which does not exist in the repository. Either:
- Remove the reference if the file is no longer needed, OR
- Replace it with the correct filename if the file was renamed.

Check git history with `git log --all --full-history -- "*COLLABORATION*"` to see if the file was ever committed under a different name before deciding.

## Constraints

- Use `git mv` for file moves, not shell `mv`, to preserve git history.

- Do not touch any file in `data/` — backup CSVs and pickle files are intentional.
